create_MissingDuplicateString: create a MissingDuplicateString task instance to generate duplicated string datasets with missing symbols
sample_batch_MissingDuplicateString: sample a batch of duplicated binary strings with one missing symbol using a JAX random key
get_input_size_MissingDuplicateString: get the input size of the MissingDuplicateString task which returns 4 for one-hot encoding
get_output_size_MissingDuplicateString: get the output size of the MissingDuplicateString task which returns 2 for binary classification
test_MissingDuplicateString_sample_batch: test the MissingDuplicateString sample_batch method generates correct one-hot encoded inputs and outputs
